authorization.request: The user asked to put the official site live first and publish the GitHub changes as well. This is the smallest required integrity fix for the already merged admin-managed ranking feature and its authorized production deployment.

objective: Keep ranking API release verification strict while accepting the exact deterministic DSH server-article navigation substitution applied after the Pages manifest is verified.

deterministicGates: Only one exact ../articles/ navigation anchor with the official Chinese or English label may be normalized; all other HTML changes must still fail the manifest hash check.
The ranking data file must continue to match its exact size and SHA-256 in release-manifest.json.
The HTML-pinned ranking digest must still match the verified data-file SHA-256.
The ranking snapshot sourceCommit must still match release-manifest.json.
The API fixture covers the deterministic server transformation and retains the tamper rejection case.
Required CI checks pass on the exact pull-request head before merge.
After merge, deploy the exact merged backend source to both registered hosts and verify public config, ranking API, and unauthenticated admin rejection.

deployment.method: Stage the exact merged backend package in a new release directory, verify fixed-file hashes and imports, atomically switch only the existing current symlink, restart dsh-model-service once per host, and roll back to the recorded prior symlink if any health gate fails.
deployment.preserve: Do not create /var/lib/dsh-store/ranking-curation.json until an administrator saves ranking choices. Do not alter API keys, model settings, Catalog, systemd, Nginx, or DSH state.

rollback: Restore only /opt/dsh-model-service/current to /opt/dsh-model-service/releases/6ee964f862a3ffaf5f454992e03d183516976e03 on the affected host, restart the existing service, and confirm the original public-config health check.
